meta.scope: Activities within ~1 hour of the Strip hotel cluster by public transit (RTC bus / Deuce / SDX / Monorail / walking). Las Vegas has NO subway — RTC buses + Las Vegas Monorail are the transit options (verified: no subway system exists).

transit_baseline.deuce: 24 hours; every 15 min 7:00am–2:00am, every 20 min 2:00–7:00am (RTC official FAQ)
transit_baseline.passes: Strip & All Access (official rtcws fares page): single $4; 2-hour $6; 24-hour $8; 3-day $20. A fare change is proposed from 2027-01-31 (pending board approval) — verify before Feb 2027 travel.
transit_baseline.downtown_trip: South Strip → downtown: under 30 min (SDX mornings) to nearly 1 hour (Deuce Fri/Sat evenings) — RTC official FAQ wording
transit_baseline.chinatown: Route 203 (Spring Mountain Rd corridor) verified on RTC route PDF; downtown→Chinatown ~30 min (Rome2Rio, non-official — cited as secondary)

meta.price_basis: 'Cost for 2' = two adult tickets, before tax/fees where ticket pages separate them.

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.location: Bellagio, 3600 S Las Vegas Blvd (center Strip)
activities.transit: Walkable from center-Strip hotels (Flamingo/LINQ/Bellagio/Cosmopolitan/Caesars); Deuce stop nearby.
activities.transit_time: 5–25 min walk from most candidate hotels
activities.hours: Mon–Fri: every 30 min 3:00–7:30pm, every 15 min 8:00pm–midnight. Sat/Sun/holidays: every 30 min 12:00–7:30pm, every 15 min 8:00pm–midnight. Weather permitting (high winds cancel).
activities.notes: Each show 3–5 min. Shows after 8pm are lit — recommended viewing.

activities.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
activities.location: Bellagio lobby, 3600 S Las Vegas Blvd
activities.transit: Same building as the Fountains — walkable from center-Strip hotels.
activities.hours: Open 24 hours (per third-party guide citing Bellagio; seasonal displays change ~5×/year)
activities.notes: 24h claim from third party — flagged unverified; check Bellagio's page for holiday exceptions.

activities.name: High Roller observation wheel
activities.transit: Walkable from center-Strip hotels; Deuce stops on Las Vegas Blvd.
activities.hours: Daily from 12:00pm; closes midnight Sun–Thu and 2:00am Fri–Sat (third-party official-reseller listings). Closed dates announced on Caesars' site — verify before booking.
activities.cost_2_adults_usd: 56–90 daytime/anytime (from $28 daytime, from $40 anytime, per 2026 reseller listings); Happy Half Hour open-bar cabin from $67 pp
activities.notes: 30-min rotation, 550 ft. Prices/hours are from 2026 reseller listings — official Caesars ticket page should be re-checked for Feb 2027 pricing; flagged unverified.

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience
activities.transit: Deuce bus from south/center Strip → downtown (RTC: 30–60 min).
activities.hours: Open 24/7 daily; Viva Vision light shows hourly 6:00pm–2:00am; free nightly concerts on three stages (per US News guide + official site calendar).
activities.cost_2_adults_usd: 0 (free admission; SlotZilla zipline and some canopy attractions extra)
activities.notes: Official site confirms free concerts 'every single night'; exact show times on official calendar.

activities.name: The Mob Museum
activities.location: 300 Stewart Ave, Downtown (2 blocks from Fremont St)
activities.transit: Deuce bus to downtown, then short walk.
activities.cost_2_adults_usd: 70 general admission (from $35 pp); Premier Pass $54.95 pp = $109.90 for 2; online non-NV discount $7 off before 11am/after 5pm

activities.name: The Neon Museum
activities.location: 770 Las Vegas Blvd N, Downtown north
activities.transit: Deuce north-bound to downtown end of route; museum is at the north edge — allow extra walking or a short rideshare.
activities.hours: 2027 admission (for Feb 2027 travel): daily 3:00–11:00pm (official ticketing page).
activities.cost_2_adults_usd: 42+ (2027 admission from $21 pp; 2026 evening $35 pp shown for 2026 visits)
activities.social_platform: Instagram (@theneonmuseumlasvegas) + TikTok (@neonmuseumlasvegas, linked on official ticket page)
activities.notes: From 2027-01-01 the museum simplifies to a single daily admission ticket (official notice).

activities.name: Sphere (The Sphere)
activities.location: 255 Sands Ave (east of Strip, behind Venetian/Palazzo)
activities.transit: Walkable from Venetian/Caesars/center Strip (~15–25 min); Deuce stops nearby.
activities.hours: Venue/event-dependent; building exterior Exosphere visible 24/7. Third-party guide lists 9:00am–10:00pm for general visits — verify per event.
activities.notes: Concert ticket prices vary by event; Feb 2027 lineup not yet verified — flagged unverified (as of 2026-11-25 the announced acts run through early 2027 but specific Feb 15–22 dates need checking on thesphere.com).

activities.name: Chinatown / Spring Mountain Rd food corridor
activities.location: W Spring Mountain Rd (between Valley View and Decatur)
activities.transit: RTC Route 203 serves the corridor (official RTC route PDF); from downtown ~30 min (Rome2Rio secondary). Deuce to west end + short bus/taxi.
activities.hours: Restaurant-by-restaurant — see michelin.html (6 MICHELIN-listed restaurants on this corridor: Kabuto, Kame Omakase, Lamaii, Partage, Pho Ga Bac Bac, Sparrow + Wolf).
activities.cost_2_adults_usd: 30–600 depending on restaurant (see michelin.html for per-restaurant verified ranges)
activities.notes: 7 of 24 MICHELIN-listed LV restaurants are in this zone — the single densest MICHELIN cluster reachable by one bus line.

activities.name: Arts District (18b) & First Friday
activities.location: S Main St, between Charleston and Colorado (Downtown south)
activities.transit: Deuce to downtown, walk south ~10 min; or Route 108/202 north-south on Main.
activities.hours: Galleries/shops generally daytime–evening hours (varies by venue); First Friday art walk monthly — Feb 2027 date = Fri Feb 5, 2027 (verify on firstfridaylv.com).
activities.cost_2_adults_usd: 0 (free to walk; food/drink extra — SoulBelly BBQ and Esther's Kitchen are here)
activities.notes: First Friday date for Feb 2027 derived from calendar — verify on official site; flagged.
